title: fix(plugin-form): converge the section-configuration to divider projection onto one path
body:
Part of #9849

⚠️ **`Part of`, deliberately, ⛔ not `Fixes`.** This PR delivers triage's deliverable for the **key** projection and hands the **gate** back under the dispatch's 回翻条款 — collapsing the gate moves a declared semantic either way. Card objectui#9849 therefore stays **open** to carry that decision: ⛔ closing it would leave the question with no carrier, which is the exact failure triage warned about on objectui#9835 (「关掉它就没有载体了」).

Clause-②: no — the convergence is module-private. `projectSectionDivider` lives in `packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts`, which `src/index.tsx` does not re-export, so nothing an author or a consumer can write moves. Tested against this diff, ⛔ not inherited: the dispatch warned that exporting a shared helper from the published entry would flip this to `yes`, and keeping it module-private is why it did not.

## The deliverable is triage's, ⛔ not the card's original one

Triage refused the p1 upgrade but kept the other half verbatim:

> **⇒ 条件的另一半照旧生效**:交付物**从「补一处 push」改成「让 section 配置到 divider 的投影只有一条路径」**,而承载它的是**本卡**

⇒ this is ⛔ not the one-key repair the card's own 「修法是一个键」 sentence describes. Adding `description:` to the offending push would have fixed the symptom and left the deliverable undone.

## The one path

Six `section-divider` pushes each rebuilt the row key by key — two in `ObjectForm.tsx`, two in `ModalForm.tsx`, two in `DrawerForm.tsx`. A key one of them forgot was invisible to the author, because its siblings on the same section arrived in the same call. That shape was carded three times running for a single key: objectui#9779 (default arm), objectui#9834 (drawer arm), objectui#9849 (the modal's derived push — the last site still dropping `description` when this branch opened). Each fix repaired one push and left the shape that produced the next.

All six now call `projectSectionDivider`. It owns the whole key set once: the blurb, the ADR-0089 `visibleWhen` predicate, the objectui#6236 membership claim, the collapse pair, the row's span and the one arm's surviving `className` read. Each arm hands its OWN resolutions over — resolved title, resolved member names, resolved collapse triple — so ⛔ no arm inherits another's semantics.

## Measurements

**Construction sites, comments stripped** (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` `stripComments`, the same instrument on both revisions and the same four-file corpus):

| revision | ObjectForm | ModalForm | DrawerForm | fieldGroups | total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `99c4eb8906` (base) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 | **6** |
| this branch | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | **2** |

⭐ LIT CONTROL, same instrument and same corpus: `applyFieldPerms` reads **7** at both revisions, so the zeros above are readings and not an instrument that sees nothing. The two remaining sites are the two row SHAPES inside the one function — the heading row and objectui#9835's blurb-only row.

**The ablation — the evidence that matters for a convergence.** Three pushes that happen to agree and one path that every arm goes through look identical from any single arm. They differ under one deletion. `description` removed ONCE from `projectSectionDivider` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor declared and verified to hit exactly once, blob `dc5d8cf941fc` to `38f651df7504` on disk before the run):

```
× ObjectForm — default layout, explicit `sections` · gate `headingOrBlurb`
× ObjectForm — default layout, DERIVED `fieldGroups` · gate `headingOrBlurb`
× ModalForm — explicit `sections`, the stacked push · gate `headingOrBlurbRow`
× ModalForm — DERIVED `fieldGroups`, the derived push · gate `heading`
× DrawerForm — explicit `sections` · gate `always`
× DrawerForm — DERIVED `fieldGroups` · gate `heading`
Tests  9 failed | 7 passed (16)
```

Every arm red, from one edit, in one run. The 7 that stayed green are the absence controls (which assert no blurb) and the blurb-only row, whose own key is a second spelling — ablated separately as leg 2, blob `dc5d8cf941fc` to `ac565f373427`, `1 failed | 15 passed`, and it reddens exactly the objectui#9835 row. Both legs restored by state, ⛔ not by exit code: `blob after restore == blob at HEAD (dc5d8cf941fc)` and `git diff HEAD` empty, printed by the tool on both legs.

**Suites.** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` gives `Test Files 104 passed (104)`, `Tests 1189 passed | 1 skipped (1190)`, under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` both exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form lint` exits 0 (0 errors, 882 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings). `check-control-bytes` exit 0; `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 and names this branch's changeset; `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims` all exit 0. ⚠️ The repo-wide `turbo run lint` across every package is CI's run, ⛔ not claimed here.

## ⚠️ The residual — handed back, ⛔ not decided

What the six sites still disagree about after the convergence is the GATE: whether a divider row exists AT ALL for a member that yields no heading. Four answers survive, and they are now enumerated in ONE place (`SectionDividerGate` in `fieldGroups.ts`) instead of scattered across three files:

| arm | gate | a headingless member with a `description` draws |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ObjectForm` default | `headingOrBlurb` | a BLURB-ONLY row: blurb and nothing else (objectui#9835 letter B) |
| `ModalForm` explicit | `headingOrBlurbRow` | one FULL row — blurb **plus** the ADR-0089 predicate and the objectui#6236 claim |
| `DrawerForm` explicit | `always` | the same full row, because that push is unconditional |
| both DERIVED pushes | `heading` | nothing |

⛔ Collapsing this union was refused here, under the dispatch's 回翻条款, because **both** directions move a declared semantic:

- moving `headingOrBlurbRow` / `always` onto `headingOrBlurb` REMOVES the ADR-0089 predicate and the membership claim from rows that carry them today;
- moving `headingOrBlurb` the other way is letter A — the widening objectui#9835 explicitly REFUSED, with the `collapsed` / `collapsible` pair riding along.

Either way it is 「a ruling about two other keys, made while fixing a blurb」 — objectui#9835's own words for exactly this.

⭐ **One measurement narrows the hand-back.** On the two DERIVED routes the gate divergence is ⛔ not author-reachable: `deriveFieldGroupSections` defaults a section's label to the group KEY, so a declared `fieldGroups` entry always yields a heading and `if (title)` cannot fail for it. The only headingless derived section is the trailing ungrouped bucket, which carries no `description` to lose. Pinned as row 4 of the new test file (a declared group with a description and NO label still yields a heading, from its key — heading `money`). ⇒ the card's second divergence is author-reachable on the EXPLICIT routes only, which is precisely where the fenced keys sit.

## The three landings this round — preserved, and pinned as they passed

⛔ Not re-pinned here: this repository treats a second reader over one population as a defect, so these are the existing owners, re-run on this branch.

1. **objectui#9778** — `customFields` MERGES over the metadata-generated set. `objectFormCustomFieldsMembers-8071` green. ⭐ And measured directly on the diff: `git diff BASE..HEAD -- packages/plugin-form/src | grep -cE '^[+-].*customFields'` prints `0` and exits 1. LIT CONTROLS on the same instrument and corpus: `projectSectionDivider` = 17, `collapsible` = 27, both exit 0. ⇒ this change does not go near that path.
2. **objectui#9835** — a headingless section with a `description` renders a blurb-only row: no divider heading, no collapse control, no predicate line. `objectFormSectionMembers-8071` green, and reddened on demand by ablation leg 2.
3. **objectui#9780** — `collapsed: true` implies collapsible, read from the DECLARATION. `collapsedImpliesCollapsible-9780` green; the resolution stays in `ObjectForm.tsx` and is handed to the projection already resolved.

The four owner files together: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)`.

## ⚠️ Known separate cards in `DrawerForm.tsx` — what this change does to them

Declared rather than left to be noticed, and ⛔ neither is fixed here.

- **The objectui#9780 trap survives in `DrawerForm`, unchanged.** One-time probe on this branch, ⛔ not left in the tree: a drawer section declaring `collapsed: true` and no `collapsible` renders **0** disclosure controls and **0** fields — still unopenable. The same section on the default arm renders **1** control. The convergence could not fix it for free: this file's explicit push and its derived push resolve the pair two further ways, and picking a winner among the three IS the `collapsed` / `collapsible` decision the dispatch fenced off. Each arm therefore hands its own resolution to the projection.
- **`DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` still REPLACE `customFields` where `ObjectForm` now merges** — untouched, per the measurement in item 1 above.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope observations, ⛔ none filed and ⛔ none fixed here:

- `SplitForm.tsx` and `TabbedForm.tsx` hold two further divider pushes (9 sites across 6 arms on the card's own count). They are outside this card's declared file surface and were ⛔ not touched. Extending the one path to them is mechanical and carries no ruling — successor: the next seat on this family, if the maintainer wants the last two arms in.
- `ModalForm`'s explicit push is the only surviving reader of a section's authored `className`; objectstack#13626 ("retire the reads", 2026-09-01) took that read off every other arm, and `sectionStyleKeysRetired-13626` pins the arms that already dropped it. The read is preserved verbatim through the projection rather than retired in passing — retiring it is that ruling's second half, ⛔ not this card's. Successor: whoever closes objectstack#13626's remaining site.
- The modal's derived push gained an inert `colSpan: 4` it did not spell before, because the projection spells it once. It reaches no grid-span wrapper: `renderFormField` returns the `SectionDivider` before that, and the component spans the row itself.
